description: This file defines a Controller class for the Admin area of an OpenCart project, providing various development tools such as clearing caches, regenerating themes, and vendor file generation.

classes.name: Developer
classes.description: Controller class providing development utility endpoints such as cache clearing, theme reset, SASS regeneration, and vendor autoload generation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the developer view with the user token.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Deletes HTML view files under view HTML directory if the user has permission.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Deletes cache files in the cache directory if the user has permission.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Deletes theme template directories under cache for theme reset if the user has permission.

methods.name: sass_catalog
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate catalog SASS files if the user has permission.

methods.name: sass_admin
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate admin SASS files if the user has permission.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates an autoload PHP file for Composer dependencies found in vendor directories if the user has permission.
